summary: Initial full-stack testing of SubOrganizer. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases PASS (auth signup/login/me/upgrade, subscriptions CRUD + toggle, seed of 11 subs, gmail mock scan returning 3, AI insights with monthly_total/yearly/by_category/basic_summary/pro_tips). Frontend: mobile flow verified end-to-end via Playwright at 390x844 — auth screen renders with hero mesh + gradient, demo-account prefill works, sign-in transitions to dashboard, all 5 tabs (dashboard, subscriptions, calendar, insights, profile) render correctly, category chip row scrolls horizontally, add-subscription form saves and appears in list (11→12 active), Scan-Gmail CTA reveals 'Found in your inbox' card with 3 mocks, Insights shows AI summary (LLM populated) plus Smart-tips blur+upgrade CTA for free user, profile shows correct stats (11/11/Free), logout returns to auth. React Native Web deprecation warnings detected: 'shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents (cosmetic, not blocking). Insights AI (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Emergent LLM key) integrated successfully — pro tips are generated.

issues: Brand favicon fetches fail with ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED for external domains (netflix.com, spotify.com, etc.) — fallback initials/brand-color circles render fine, but many console errors are logged. Consider bundling logos or using a favicon CDN that's whitelisted, or suppress network errors.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on React Native Web — use style.boxShadow instead. 6 occurrences across app/ and src/. Reference: /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx (styles.card, styles.segActive, styles.busyBtn) and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (tbStyles.wrap).

'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning surfaces during Auth->Dashboard transition. Likely originating from Animated wrappers; audit any pointerEvents='none' props in animated cards.

Console error 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' — from reanimated web shim; upgrading reanimated or its web adapter should resolve. Cosmetic only, no functional impact.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence React Native Web deprecation warnings (auth.tsx card/segActive/busyBtn, tabs/_layout.tsx wrap, and 2 other files).
(Optional cosmetic) Bundle brand logos locally or gate the domain favicon fetch behind Platform.OS !== 'web' to eliminate ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED console noise on web preview.
(Optional) Investigate 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warning — usually from an Animated view; move pointerEvents to style block.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes _id from all queries/responses correctly; JWT auth via HTTPBearer with 30d expiry is clean.

seed_subscriptions runs unconditionally on every signup — for the pre-seeded demo user this means each fresh signup on a fresh DB would attempt to reseed; login path is guarded (only signup seeds), so behavior is correct.
AI insights gracefully falls back to defaults when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing or LLM throws — good defensive coding.
server.py is 348 lines — still under the 700 threshold; splitting into routers/{auth,subs,insights}.py is a future refactor.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct pattern) and testIDs are present on every interactive element required for testing.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates fresh TEST_<uuid>@example.com signup per session and TEST_UI_Sub via UI. Demo user demo@suborganizer.app was already seeded and now has 12 active subs (was 11 + 1 added during UI test). No cleanup was performed for the UI-added row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Demo user demo@suborganizer.app / demo1234 already exists. UI test added 1 subscription named 'TEST_UI_Sub' to the demo user which was NOT cleaned up; the demo user therefore has 12 active subs (not the original 11). If a future test asserts exactly 11 for the demo user it will fail — either delete TEST_UI_Sub via API first or update the assertion. Playwright must use mobile viewport 390x844 and click with force=True. Auth screen testIDs: auth-tab-login, auth-tab-signup, auth-name-input, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit, auth-demo, auth-error. Tabs: tab-dashboard/subscriptions/calendar/insights/profile. Dashboard: dashboard-scan-gmail, dashboard-add-sub. Add-form: form-name, form-amount, form-save. Insights: insights-upgrade. Profile: profile-logout.
